questions.text: What is the main goal of a Bugfix Spec in Kiro?

options.label: Turn the defect report into current, expected, and unchanged behavior, investigate the root cause, and plan a verifiable fix
Start with the proposed technical solution and derive later which existing behaviors may change
Generate only a regression test and defer root-cause analysis until task execution
Apply the smallest possible change without documenting behavior that must remain unchanged

questions.explanation: A Bugfix Spec records the current behavior (defect), expected behavior, and unchanged behavior in bugfix.md. Kiro then explores the codebase to document the root cause and proposed fix in design.md and generates verifiable tasks in tasks.md.

questions.text: The bugfix.md file should record not only the defect and expected outcome, but also existing behaviors that must remain unchanged.
questions.explanation: True. The bug-analysis phase separates Current Behavior, Expected Behavior, and Unchanged Behavior. The last section defines regression boundaries so the fix does not damage related functionality.

questions.text: Kiro has finished exploring the codebase while generating a Bugfix Spec design. What should design.md record?

options.label: The root cause, proposed fix, and properties covering incorrect, corrected, and unchanged behavior
Only the original stack trace and a list of possibly related files, without choosing a fix approach
The final fix implementation and all test results, making tasks.md unnecessary
Only acceptance criteria rewritten in EARS format, duplicating bugfix.md

questions.explanation: During design, Kiro explores the codebase and documents the root cause and proposed fix. The design also defines properties that capture the incorrect behavior, validate the corrected behavior, and protect unchanged behavior.

questions.text: Arrange the steps of the Bugfix Spec flow in the correct order:

options.label: Generate bugfix.md with current, expected, and unchanged behavior
Explore the codebase and identify the root cause
Generate design.md with the proposed fix and correctness properties
Generate tasks.md with tasks and property-based tests
Execute the tasks to implement and validate the fix without regressions

questions.explanation: The documented flow has three phases: Bug Analysis (bugfix.md), Design (exploration, root cause, solution, and properties), and Tasks (a plan with tests). Implementation happens when the generated tasks are executed.
